title: Meenakshi v. State of Tamil Nadu
text: The petitioner-workman, Meenakshi, was engaged as a contract worker for 11 years with the respondent government establishment. She claims regularisation of service under the Industrial Disputes Act and State government circular on regularisation of contract workers. The workman performed perennial and permanent duties identical to regular employees. Under the Industrial Disputes Act and pursuant to the Supreme Court's decisions on equal pay and regularisation, continued contract employment for perennial posts is impermissible. The retrenchment of the workman without following Section 25F of the Industrial Disputes Act is void. The court directs reinstatement of the workman on a regular post with notional continuity of service from the date of her initial engagement. Back wages at 50% are awarded for the period of illegal retrenchment. The workman's service shall be regularised as directed.
